payload.summary: A grounded first-choice extractive answer is never quality-checked, so incoherent answers ship with no fallback reason recorded
payload.detail: Found 2026-08-22 while diagnosing #231 against the 60 Gate E answers (see docs/rag-improvement/231-diagnosis-2026-08-22.md section 3.2). The first-choice extractive branch in src/lib/rag/rag.ts runs from line 3002 to 3182 and contains exactly ONE answer-quality check. It is guarded on ungroundedness at rag.ts:3107: extractiveNeedsReviewFallback requires !finalizedAnswer.grounded, and generatedAnswerQualityFailureReason (src/lib/rag/rag-extractive-answer.ts:3252) is called only inside that block. A grep of rag.ts:3002-3182 returns that single call site. Consequence: a grounded extractive answer bypasses incomplete_opening_sentence, bad_final_answer_quality, fragment_like_answer, low_yield_answer, template_like_answer and every other predicate that function owns. EVIDENCE, two real answers, byte-identical in both Gate E runs, both grounded true with citation_count 5, degraded_mode.active false, no fallback_reason and no generation_quality_gate_reasons. For 'What metabolic monitoring is required for antipsychotics?' the delivered answer is: The guidance for metabolic is that compliance, monitoring and evaluation. For 'What discharge documentation is required?' it is: The guidance is that aim > To effectively identify admission and discharge processes to facilitate ease of access to > 2. These are the two worst outputs in the whole 30-case capture and every metric built on fallback_reason scored them as clean, including the Gate E blinded tally and #231's own framing. NOT YET PROVEN: whether those two strings would actually be rejected by generatedAnswerQualityFailureReason if it ran. The predicates are regex-dense and were not executed in the diagnosis session. That focused test is the mandatory FIRST step of any fix -- if either string passes every predicate, the finding becomes gate strictness rather than gate reachability and the fix is a different one. NEXT: run that test, then move the quality check out from under the !grounded guard. Keep the change to the guard condition only; do not alter a predicate, threshold or scorer, do not touch ranking, selection or the generation prompt, and do not change answerRouteBudgetMs. EXPECT eval impact: this will convert some currently-clean answers into review fallbacks and tests/eval-quality.test.ts:471 treats source_backed_review_fallback_count above 0 as a blocking threshold, so measure it rather than adjusting the threshold to fit. STOP: protected RAG surface, flag before editing, needs a live eval-canary pair which is a separate owner approval. A paste-ready packet prompt is in section 8 of the diagnosis doc.
